title: Hidden Thoughts Are Not Secret: Reasoning Trace Exposure in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.00642v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reasoning traces have become a valuable form of learning signals for improving and transferring the capabilities of large language models. In particular, detailed traces can help distill reasoning behavior from stronger teacher models into weaker student models. The value of capability transfer has motivated many deployed systems with reasoning models to hide raw internal traces and expose at most summaries and answers to users. As a result, we ask whether such interface-level trace hiding prevents users from obtaining useful reasoning supervision through prompting. We study this question with Reasoning Exposure Prompting (REP), a lightweight in-context elicitation method that uses shadow-model-generated demonstrations wrapped in auxiliary code-like formats to raise user-visible reasoning traces from a victim model. Across the common reasoning dataset, different victim models, and different student model distillation, REP substantial

translated_title: 隐藏的想法并非秘密：大语言模型中的推理痕迹暴露
translated_abstract: 推理痕迹已成为一种宝贵的学习信号，可用于提升和迁移大语言模型的能力。特别是，详细的推理痕迹能够帮助将较强教师模型的推理行为蒸馏到较弱的学生模型中。能力迁移的价值促使许多部署了推理模型的系统隐藏原始内部推理痕迹，最多只向用户暴露摘要和答案。因此，我们提出疑问：这种接口层面的痕迹隐藏能否阻止用户通过提示获取有用的推理监督信号。我们使用推理暴露提示来研究这一问题，这是一种轻量级的上下文引导方法，它利用影子模型生成的示例并将其包裹在辅助的类代码格式中，以从受害模型中引出用户可见的推理痕迹。在常见推理数据集、不同受害模型以及不同的学生模型蒸馏实验中，REP均表现出显著效果。
tldr: 本文提出推理暴露提示（REP）方法，证明即使部署系统在接口层面隐藏了推理模型的原始推理痕迹，用户仍可通过轻量级提示技术获取有用的推理监督信号并实现能力蒸馏，因此隐藏推理痕迹并不能真正保护模型内部思维。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Reasoning Exposure Prompting (REP), demonstrating that interface-level hiding of reasoning traces in deployed LLMs does not prevent users from eliciting useful reasoning supervision for distillation through lightweight prompting.
